name: kanban-board
title: A Kanban board shows each program, and then the epics and slices of one program
outcome: A reader opens one Kanban board in the viewer and sees every program as a card in its stage column. A click on a program card opens the board of that program, which shows each epic and slice in its status column.
done_when: the program board shows every program of the record index as a card in the column of its stage, with its epic counts by status and its slice count
a click on a program card opens the epic board of that program, and one control leads back to the program board
the epic board shows each epic of the program in the column of its status, and a switch shows the slices in place of the epics
a text search narrows both boards, a sort changes the order of the program cards, and the reader can hide a column
the board is a full page of its own, and the Work drawer still opens over each surface
the board changes no workflow state, and a card of a program opens the program, epic, or slice level of the viewer
slices that belong to no program show in one group named No program, and the group is absent when no such slice exists
the board reads the record index only, and it holds no second source of workflow state
the board header shows the build time of the record index
the address holds the search, the sort, the hidden columns, and the open program, and a reload restores the board
a copy icon on a card that has a next workflow copies a start prompt for that record, and the board then shows the notice Prompt copied
abort_if: the program board cannot show the five stage columns at 1280 by 800 without a sideways scroll of the page

min_work.derived_from: 2 districts (viewer, shared), 1 colliding ADR (ADR-0034), 4 related ADRs, 2 stack-card boundary rules, 4 clickable prototypes on the real index

out_of_scope_note: The engineer removed the multi-selection of programs and the vertical swim lanes on 2026-11-14. A later design may add them.

epics.outcome: A read-only full page shows programs by stage, and a click opens the epics and slices of one program by status (ADR-0050).

rounds.note: Draft review scored 0.64. Three blockers: the status map is not exhaustive, a slice with no program has no epic page, and the slice address needs a route field.
